Body.Content:
What and why

Microsoft is retiring calendar syncing between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace. After this retirement, organizations will no longer be able to synchronize calendars between the two services using the calendar sync capability available through the Admin app in Teams.

This change allows us to focus our investments on supported integration experiences, including the Microsoft Teams Meeting add-on for Google Workspace.

Rollout schedule

  • Retirement: October 2026

We began notifying affected customers in August 2026. Calendar syncing between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace will no longer be supported starting in October 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

Organizations currently using the calendar syncing capability between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace through the Admin app in Teams.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams
  • Google Workspace

What will happen

  • Calendar syncing between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace will no longer be supported.
  • Calendars that were previously matched and configured for synchronization will stop syncing.
  • Administrators will no longer have access to calendar sync setup in the Admin app in Teams.

Action required and recommendations

To prepare for this retirement, administrators should:

  1. Notify affected users that calendar synchronization will stop in October 2026.
  2. Retrieve and retain any account matching information they may need from the Admin app in Teams before the retirement date.
  3. For users who need to schedule Microsoft Teams meetings from Google Calendar, recommend the Microsoft Teams Meeting add-on for Google Workspace.

Learn more

  • Microsoft Teams Meeting add-on for Google Workspace
  • Set up calendar syncing between Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams for your business | Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Learn

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified.
